record.context_brief: All stability conditions on Ku(X) for a cubic threefold
record.original_question: Let X be a cubic threefold. If sigma is any stability condition on the Kuznetsov component Ku(X), is sigma in the same orbit as the explicitly constructed stability conditions sigma(s, q, mu)? Equivalently, is every stability condition on Ku(X) Serre-invariant?

evidence.quote: Question 5.25. Let sigma be a stability condition on Ku(X) of a cubic threefold X. Is sigma in the same orbit of sigma(s, q, mu)? Equivalently, is sigma Serre-invariant?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^4$ be a smooth cubic threefold over $\mathbb{C}$, and let
$$\mathrm{Ku}(X) := \langle \mathcal{O}_X, \mathcal{O}_X(1) \rangle^{\perp} \subset D^b(X)$$
denote its Kuznetsov component, i.e. the full triangulated subcategory of the bounded derived category of coherent sheaves on $X$ right-orthogonal to the exceptional collection $\mathcal{O}_X, \mathcal{O}_X(1)$. The category $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$ is a fractional Calabi–Yau category of dimension $5/3$, with Serre functor $S_{\mathrm{Ku}(X)}$.

There is an explicit family of Bridgeland stability conditions $\sigma(s, q, \mu)$ on $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$ constructed by tilting the standard heart on $D^b(X)$ with parameters $(s, q, \mu)$ in an appropriate region, and restricting to $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$. All these stability conditions are Serre-invariant, meaning that $S_{\mathrm{Ku}(X)} \cdot \sigma = \sigma \cdot \widetilde{g}$ for some $\widetilde{g} \in \widetilde{\mathrm{GL}}^{+}_2(\mathbb{R})$, and they all lie in a single orbit under the action of $\widetilde{\mathrm{GL}}^{+}_2(\mathbb{R})$ on the stability manifold $\mathrm{Stab}(\mathrm{Ku}(X))$.

Question: Is every Bridgeland stability condition $\sigma$ on $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$ contained in the $\widetilde{\mathrm{GL}}^{+}_2(\mathbb{R})$-orbit of the stability conditions $\sigma(s, q, \mu)$? Equivalently, is every Bridgeland stability condition on $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$ Serre-invariant?
artifact.category_tag: Bridgeland stability conditions on Kuznetsov components
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work characterizes Serre-invariant stability conditions on Ku(X) of a cubic threefold as exactly those of homological dimension at most 2, and shows they form a single contractible connected component of Stab(Ku(X)) (a single GL2+(R)-orbit). However, the existence of non-Serre-invariant stability conditions (on other connected components) is not ruled out, and the full question of whether every stability condition is Serre-invariant remains open.

status_evidence.title: Serre-invariant stability conditions and Ulrich bundles on cubic threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: All known stability conditions on Ku(X) are Serre-invariant and lie in the same orbit with respect to the action of the universal cover of GL2+(R).
status_evidence.claim: All currently constructed stability conditions on Ku(X) of a cubic threefold are Serre-invariant and form a single orbit.

status_evidence.title: Stability manifolds of Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: A stability condition sigma on Ku(X) is Serre-invariant if and only if its homological dimension is at most 2; all Serre-invariant stability conditions form a contractible connected component of the stability manifold.
status_evidence.claim: Serre-invariant stability conditions are characterized by homological dimension ≤ 2 and form one contractible component, but the question of whether every stability condition is Serre-invariant is not settled.
